title: Composite sensor (super-sensor)
description: A named state built from several atlas entries. Draft, see docs/research/sensor-grouping.md. Layers: L0 signal, L1 feature, L2 context, L3 intent, L4 action.

id.description: ctx.* for L2 contexts, intent.* for L3 intents.

ref.description: An atlas id, or another composite for stacking.

scope.description: Console stream that produces it, when one exists.

role.description: required: no state without it. evidence: raises or lowers belief. veto: forces the state off. prior: static context that shifts thresholds. blind_spot: the page cannot read it; another surface can.

feature.description: L1 feature computed from the reading, with its window.

weight.description: Log odds added when the evidence is present (negative lowers belief).

window.description: Sliding window, e.g. 30s/5s means 30 s wide, every 5 s.

enter.description: Probability needed to enter the state.

exit.description: Probability below which the state ends (hysteresis).

via.description: Console scope, atlas action id or MCP tool.

sensitivity.description: Max of the inputs, plus one when it infers a state about a person.
